title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
journal: Proceedings of the 36th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology
authors: Joon Sung Park; Joseph O'Brien; Carrie Jun Cai; Meredith Ringel Morris; Percy Liang; Michael S. Bernstein
abstract: Believable proxies of human behavior can empower interactive applications ranging from immersive environments to rehearsal spaces for interpersonal communication to prototyping tools. In this paper, we introduce generative agents: computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior. Generative agents wake up, cook breakfast, and head to work; artists paint, while authors write; they form opinions, notice each other, and initiate conversations; they remember and reflect on days past as they plan the next day. To enable generative agents, we describe an architecture that extends a large language model to store a complete record of the agent’s experiences using natural language, synthesize those memories over time into higher-level reflections, and retrieve them dynamically to plan behavior. We instantiate generative agents to populate an interactive sandbox environment inspired by The Sims, where end users can interact with a small town of twenty-five agents using natural language. In an evaluation, these generative agents produce believable individual and emergent social behaviors. We demonstrate through ablation that the components of our agent architecture—observation, planning, and reflection—each contribute critically to the believability of agent behavior. By fusing large language models with computational interactive agents, this work introduces architectural and interaction patterns for enabling believable simulations of human behavior.
abstractZh: 可信的人类行为代理能够支持多种交互应用，从沉浸式环境、人际沟通演练空间到原型设计工具。本文提出生成式智能体，即模拟可信人类行为的计算软件智能体。它们会起床、做早餐、上班；艺术家绘画，作家写作；它们形成观点、注意彼此并发起交谈；在计划下一天时，会记忆和反思过去的日子。为实现生成式智能体，我们提出一种扩展大语言模型的架构，以自然语言完整记录智能体经历，随时间将记忆综合为更高层次的反思，并动态检索这些记忆来规划行为。我们将生成式智能体部署到受《模拟人生》启发的交互沙盒环境中，终端用户可通过自然语言与一个由25个智能体组成的小镇互动。评估表明，这些智能体能够产生可信的个体行为和涌现的社会行为。例如，仅由用户指定某个智能体希望举办情人节聚会这一初始想法，智能体就在随后两天自主传播聚会邀请、结识新朋友、互相邀请作为聚会约会对象，并协调在正确时间一起出席。消融实验表明，智能体架构中的观察、规划与反思组件，均对行为可信性具有关键贡献。通过融合大语言模型与计算交互智能体，本文提出支持可信人类行为模拟的架构与交互模式。
